info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Operational Services Rewards-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Operational Services Rewards API provides users with access to detailed information about various rewards associated with banking operational services. This endpoint allows clients to retrieve a list of available rewards, offering insights into customer incentives and benefits. Typical consumers of this API include banking partners, customer support teams, and financial analysts who aim to enhance customer engagement and retention strategies. The API is designed to support efficient exploration and integration of rewards, contributing to an enriched customer experience.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the latest rewards information available in the operational services. It provides insights into the current rewards structure and any applicable updates.

requestBody.description: Request body for the operational services rewards endpoint, which allows clients to retrieve information about rewards. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema to facilitate proper processing of the request.
